texts.name: 1. Build exactly the 6 frames below, named exactly as listed (one state per frame), and wire them as a clickable prototype with the listed links. 2. Everything in “Must include” must appear on that frame. The lists are grouped by subject and sorted alphabetically — they are not in screen order and say nothing about layout, grouping, emphasis or styling. Those are your decisions. 3. The brand primary color, the typeface and dark mode in 01 · Foundations are fixed. Define every other color yourself (dark background and surface levels, neutrals, text, gain / loss, selected, warning, error / disabled, chart colors), plus type scale, spacing, radii and elevation, and apply them consistently. 4. 02 · Components gives only a default Button, a default Text Field and the platform shell (status bar, home indicator). Design all other states, the headers, the tab bar, tabs and chips, and every business component as reusable components in your file. 5. Use the company logos, ticker marks and icons from 04 · Media. 6. Copy and data must match “Fixed data” exactly (Indonesian number format: Rp2.125.000 · 0,58%). This brief wins over anything you may know of the original kit.
texts.text:
1. Build exactly the 6 frames below, named exactly as listed (one state per frame), and wire them as a clickable prototype with the listed links.
2. Everything in “Must include” must appear on that frame. The lists are grouped by subject and sorted alphabetically — they are not in screen order and say nothing about layout, grouping, emphasis or styling. Those are your decisions.
3. The brand primary color, the typeface and dark mode in 01 · Foundations are fixed. Define every other color yourself (dark background and surface levels, neutrals, text, gain / loss, selected, warning, error / disabled, chart colors), plus type scale, spacing, radii and elevation, and apply them consistently.
4. 02 · Components gives only a default Button, a default Text Field and the platform shell (status bar, home indicator). Design all other states, the headers, the tab bar, tabs and chips, and every business component as reusable components in your file.
5. Use the company logos, ticker marks and icons from 04 · Media.
6. Copy and data must match “Fixed data” exactly (Indonesian number format: Rp2.125.000 · 0,58%). This brief wins over anything you may know of the original kit.

Kasir akan menanyakan kode pembayaran. Berikan kode pembayaran Anda 1111000065665144. 4. Kasir akan melakukan konfirmasi data konsumen berupa Nama Merchant, Nama Konsumen, dan Nominal. Lakukan pembayaran ke kasir sejumlah nominal yang disebutkan. 5. Terima struk sebagai bukti pembayaran sudah sukses dilakukan. Notifikasi pembayaran akan langsung diterima oleh Merchant. 6. Selesai.
